name: tempmail
title: TempMail
description: A temporary mailbox with a disposable address, for one-off signups.
author: black

commands.name: mailbox
commands.title: Open Mailbox
commands.description: Read the mail, watch the countdown, extend or replace the address

commands.name: check-mail
commands.title: Check For Mail
commands.description: In the background: report new mail as a notification and throw away an address whose time is up

commands.name: reset
commands.title: Reset TempMail
commands.description: Throw away the current address and everything in it

preferences.name: defaultDuration
preferences.title: Address Lifetime
preferences.description: How long a new address is allowed to live. An address never lives more than 60 minutes from now, however often it is extended.

preferences.name: pollInterval
preferences.title: Check For Mail Every
preferences.description: How often the inbox refreshes while it is open. The API allows 30 requests a minute, so a short interval leaves no room for actions.

preferences.name: notifyNewMail
preferences.title: New Mail Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when mail arrives
preferences.description: Says who sent it and nothing else: a subject often carries the code the mail was sent to deliver.

scripts.test: tsx test/mail.test.ts && tsx test/when.test.ts && tsx test/body.test.ts && tsx test/codes.test.ts && tsx test/html.test.ts && tsx test/seen.test.ts
